context: User asks for a list of unrelated one-liners; the skill should consolidate this into one extended metaphor instead.

checklist.name: consolidates_into_one_metaphor
checklist.description: Consolidates the request into one extended, escalating metaphor rather than a list of unrelated jokes.

checklist.name: build_then_puncture
checklist.description: At least one sentence builds in length then is punctured by a short, blunt clause.

checklist.name: jargon_beat_optional
checklist.description: Optionally includes a jargon-mockery beat if it fits; not required for a short piece.

checklist.name: original_wording
checklist.description: Original invented wording throughout, with no copied lines from a real source.

checklist.name: flat_or_bleak_ending
checklist.description: Ends flat or bleak rather than triumphant.
